title: carex obtusifolia

This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
